'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hi there homie, I have a solid business proposal for you. Don't you worry, I’m not bullshitting you, it's the real deal. Can’t say what it is right now, but if it starts off good, I’ll be sure to tell you. I need a big backpack, the purple "Pilgrim" one, and a ski hat, you know, with ninja-type slits. Look for them yourself though, no traders, brother. I need to keep this in secret, don't want anyone to find out about our little thing, you know?}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 25 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Find 1 [[Ski hat with holes for eyes]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 1 [[Ski hat with holes for eyes]] to [[Ragman]]
* Find 1 [[Pilgrim tourist backpack]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 1 [[Pilgrim tourist backpack]] to [[Ragman]]

==Rewards==
* +12,300 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 25,000 Roubles
** 26,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 28,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Black)]]
* 1× [[Walker's XCEL 500BT Digital headset]]
* Unlocks craft for [[6B23-2 body armor (Mountain Flora)]] at [[Hideout#modules|Lavatory level 1]]
{{quote|Taken off dead Scavs, I presume? Whatever, that’ll do. Everything is going according to the plan, so come by for the next task later.}}
